<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif">
    <!-- Status bar -->
    <text x="24" y="27" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="22" x2="316" y2="27" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="19" x2="321" y2="27" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="27" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="25" x2="344" y2="19" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="353" y="16" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="355" y="18" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    <line x1="376" y1="19" x2="378" y2="24" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Greeting -->
    <text x="24" y="94" font-size="32" line-height="48px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Hello Again!</text>
    <text x="24" y="128" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Welcome back, you’ve been missed.</text>

    <!-- Username field -->
    <text x="24" y="169" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="178" width="342" height="56" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="205" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="45" cy="220" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="66" y="211" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">alex.morgan</text>

    <!-- Password field -->
    <text x="24" y="264" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="273" width="342" height="56" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <path d="M38 297 C42 289 52 289 57 297" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M38 297 C42 305 52 305 57 297" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="47.5" cy="297" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="66" y="306" font-size="18" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="2px" fill="#050505">••••••••</text>
    <path d="M343 290 C348 290 352 294 352 299" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <path d="M343 308 C348 308 352 304 352 299" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.4"/>

    <!-- Password support row -->
    <rect x="24" y="353" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <polyline points="28,363 33,368 41,358" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="368" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Remember me</text>
    <text x="264" y="368" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Forgot Password?</text>

    <!-- Login button -->
    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="24" y="400" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="195" y="431" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Log In</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Divider -->
    <line x1="24" y1="480" x2="166" y2="480" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="485" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">or continue with</text>
    <line x1="224" y1="480" x2="366" y2="480" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Social buttons -->
    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="505" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="529" r="10" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <path d="M52 523 L49 523 C47 523 46 525 46 527 L46 530 L43 530 L43 534 L46 534 L46 541 L50 541 L50 534 L53 534 L54 530 L50 530 L50 527 C50 526 51 526 52 526 L54 526 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <path d="M48 525 L48 541" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="115" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Facebook</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="203" y="505" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
      <path d="M229 529 L229 527 C229 521 234 517 240 517 C243 517 246 518 248 520 L245 523 C244 522 242 521 240 521 C236 521 233 524 233 529 C233 534 236 537 240 537 C242 537 244 536 245 535 L245 532 L240 532 L240 528 L249 528 L249 537 C247 539 244 541 240 541 C234 541 229 537 229 529 Z" fill="#4285F4"/>
      <path d="M240 517 C243 517 246 518 248 520 L245 523 C244 522 242 521 240 521 Z" fill="#34A853"/>
      <path d="M229 529 L233 529 C233 534 236 537 240 537 L240 541 C234 541 229 537 229 529 Z" fill="#FBBC05"/>
      <path d="M245 535 L249 537 C247 539 244 541 240 541 L240 537 C242 537 244 536 245 535 Z" fill="#EB4335"/>
      <text x="294" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Google</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Account prompt -->
    <text x="195" y="596" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Don’t have an account?  <tspan fill="#1877F2" font-weight="600">Sign up</tspan></text>

    <!-- Bottom navigation -->
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="28" y="779" width="64" height="40" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="52,789 42,798 42,810 62,810 62,798" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polygon points="40,799 52,788 64,799" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="60" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>

    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="145" cy="799" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="148,795 146,802 140,804 142,798" fill="#667080"/>
    <text x="145" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Explore</text>

    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <rect x="228" y="789" width="16" height="21" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="228,810 236,805 244,810" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="236" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Saved</text>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="325" cy="796" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="314" y="805" width="22" height="10" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="325" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
